comment: The tools this workflow needs in order to prove Gate A. bin/craft-toolchain reads this file, reports which ones are missing, and installs them on request. config/workflow.md section 6 remains the human-readable source for the Tests, Lint, Import order and Format rows; this file names the packages behind them and adds the optional tools that section 6 does not mention. A tool marked required:true cannot be missing without the workflow losing the ability to prove a check ran. A tool marked required:false makes review better but never gates. Each entry is satisfied when any one of its any_of commands is on PATH, which is how the Format row means 'detect black or pyink'.

tools.purpose: Lint. Gate A does not pass until lint passes.
Import order. Gate A does not pass until it is clean.
Formatting. Either formatter satisfies this row.
tools.source: config/workflow.md section 6, Format row, and standards/python_code_style.ai.md

tools.purpose: The test runner. Section 6 runs it inside the container, so a host copy is a convenience, not the checkpoint.
A type checker and language server. It gives the reviewers real diagnostics instead of read-and-infer, which is cheaper and more accurate than a model reading for `X | None`.
tools.source: Not in section 6. Optional, and it never gates.

forbidden.reason: config/workflow.md section 6 says: Never `yapf`. standards/python_code_style.ai.md picks black or pyink. Never install it, and never propose it, whoever asks.
